page.overview:
What is Prince of Ithilien?

Prince of Ithilien, was a title created for Faramir, the Steward of Gondor and his descendants by King Elessar after the War of the Ring.

King Elessar created the subsidiary titles of Prince of Ithilien and Lord of Emyn Arnen for Faramir, the Steward of Gondor and invested Faramir as the first Prince of Ithilien on May 1, 3019. Following the death of Faramir in FO 82, his son Elboron succeeded him as the second Prince of Ithilien.

The Prince's guard was known as the White Company.
